name: Jonadab
description: David's nephew living at the time of United Monarchy

points: Jonadab asked Amnon why he, the king's son, was lean from day to day, and Amnon confessed he loved Tamar. Jonadab told him to lie down and make himself sick, and when David came to see him, to ask that Tamar come and dress meat in his sight that he might eat at her hand.

note.label: 2 Samuel 13: Amnon Forces Tamar and Absalom Slays Amnon

points: While they were on the way, tidings came to David that Absalom had slain all the king's sons and not one was left. The king arose, tare his garments, and lay on the earth. But Jonadab said not to suppose all were slain, for Amnon only was dead; by the appointment of Absalom this had been determined from the day Amnon forced his sister Tamar.
The report was exaggerated, so David thought all his sons were dead. Jonadab corrected him: only Amnon was dead, and it was because of what Amnon had done to Tamar.
